title: ChristmasTech
description: This is a Winter/Christmas themed techmod kitchensink pack
body:
# ChristmasTech
ChristmasTech is a festive Minecraft kitchen-sink modpack that blends holiday charm with powerful tech mods. Explore snowy landscapes, automate huge factories, decorate your world for the season, and enjoy a cozy yet high-tech adventure. With a wide mix of mods for building, crafting, automation, exploration, and decoration, this pack offers something for every type of player. Whether you're engineering massive redstone-inspired machines or creating the perfect Christmas village, ChristmasTech delivers a fun, feature-rich experience for the holidays.

For more Information also check out the Github-Repository
https://github.com/7stain/ChristmasTech
